notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. Governing documents: the 2010-2017 CUNY-PSC collective agreement (2018_03; term ended 2017-11-30; its version note says it remained in force under the Taylor Law status quo on the reference date), the December 8, 2011 CUNY-PSC letter agreement (2018_04) and the PSC's reproduction of the March 19, 2009 Paid Parental Leave letter agreement as modified (2018_05), plus the CUNY FMLA policy posted by Graduate Center HR (2018_08). A governing document for faculty leave exists, so missing is false (the rule for records with no governing document, reader instructions §3, does not apply).

Summaries: 2018_01 and 2018_06 are PSC union pages summarising paid parental leave; 2018_07 is a PSC summary of sick leave. They agree with the agreement and letter texts and add nothing coded on their own.

2018_00 is a Graduate Center form for a special leave of absence without pay; its purposes are limited to 'research, writing, creative work, study, or public service', so a parent cannot use it for a birth or adoption: not a component. It states that such a leave breaks service toward tenure.
2018_09 is a Graduate Center HR form for unpaid child care leave for classified staff only (Blue and White Collar agreements); coded as c17 with that group.

Persons employed as substitutes without an underlying regular annual appointment are not eligible for paid parental leave (footnote 5; letter para. 1). Article 16 (temporary disability, child care leave, paid parental leave) does not apply to Medical series and Law School titles (Art. 1.1 and Arts. 34.2, 35.5 list the articles that apply); EOC titles receive Article 16 except 16.5 and 16.6 (Supplemental Agreement on EOCs). The Graduate Center's tenure-stream faculty hold Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor titles in the PSC unit, so the agreement's Article 16 covers them.

Paid parental leave scheduling for teaching faculty (letter para. 4): a Fall-to-Spring leave starting between December 15 and the start of Spring may be replaced for its balance by a one-course Spring reduction (c14, discretionary); a Spring leave interrupted by the summer annual leave period resumes for its remaining weeks on the first day of the Fall semester (the parties intend no faculty member to be on leave from teaching for two semesters); a parent eligible during the summer annual leave starts on the first day of the Fall semester. These are recorded in c1's duration_note.

Child care leave (c10, c11) and paid parental leave (c1) are not linked to each other: no document fixes their order or says a parent takes one after the other (U3: unlinked leaves are not added). FMLA (c9) is linked concurrent_with both, as the FMLA policy counts the first 12 weeks of any qualifying authorized leave.

Birth parent chain: temporary disability leave from the accrued balance (c2, no coded length) -> Paid Parental Leave up to 8 weeks (c1), with FMLA 12 weeks (c9) concurrent from the start of c2; c1 lies within the discretionary balance-of-semester relief (c15); unpaid temporary disability leave (c3) and donated sick leave (c6, c7) follow the c2 balance; separately, special child care leave 1 semester (c10) -> extension up to 1 year (c11), with FMLA concurrent.

Non-birth parent chain: Paid Parental Leave up to 8 weeks (c1), with FMLA 12 weeks (c9) concurrent, within the discretionary balance-of-semester relief (c15); separately, special child care leave 1 semester (c10) -> extension up to 1 year (c11), with FMLA concurrent.
c1 carries two links: consecutive_after c2 for the birth parent (letter para. 3) and within c15 (R3b). c2 has no coded length, so both place c1 at the start; R15 lets consecutive_after place first.

Cross-references not saved: the signed March 19, 2009 Paid Parental Leave Letter Agreement (its text as modified is reproduced in 2018_05); the 2007-2010 CUNY-PSC agreement and its Memorandum of Agreement (Sections 16 'Paid Parental Leave' and 17); the PSC-CUNY Welfare Fund long-term disability plan; the PSC 'Q&A on Paid Parental Leave for HEOs' and 'Dedicated Sick Leave Agreement--April 2010' pages; the Board Bylaws and Multiple Position Policy; the University Retrenchment Guidelines; letter agreements of August 17, 2010, February 7, 2012 and February 27, 2014 (research awards), April 24, 2013 and October 15, 2013 (adjunct health insurance), June 16, 2016 MOA and December 8, 2017 workload plan.

Not components: bereavement leave (14.10, death only); jury duty (Art. 17); fellowship leaves and Scholar Incentive Awards (research only); professional reassignments (library research); Medical Separation Leave (Art. 21A, imposed by CUNY for unfitness); retirement (Travia) leave and phased retirement; annual leave of teaching faculty (a fixed summer period, not a balance a parent can draw on for a birth).
